title: Lower Bounds for Linear-Oracle Online Learning
summary: Can a constant number of linear minimizations per round improve on the $T^{3/4}$ regret rate of online Frank-Wolfe on general convex sets? Weibel et al. conjectured that fixed-coefficient methods cannot. We prove their conjecture and extend the lower bound to every deterministic learner in an oracle-only model. The learner receives an initial feasible point and a diameter bound, and must remain feasible on every domain consistent with its oracle replies.
